completionDiagnosticLimitations: Separate instrumented candidate before primitive-exception correction; normal delivery path unchanged. Includes warmup, native callback ready to native poll delivery plus a JS microtask checkpoint proxy. Not GPU execution or physical input/display latency. Probes removed before final measurement.

engineGcContractPassed: background Dart isolates reject runtime creation before allocation
background GC preserves JS-rooted Dart callback targets
engine contexts isolate globals, microtasks and reference ownership
either business owner retains real private fields and callback identity
sessions share a Dart owner without sharing JS references or shutdown
joint marking follows callback cycles through three sessions
Dart callback facades retain direct targets through allocation GC
Dart roots propagate through direct JS and Dart callback chains
JS-only roots retain unmarked Dart targets through allocation GC
idle JS collection releases wrappers of live Dart targets
active JS collection tolerates expired Dart origins
idle GC reclaims rootless callbacks and 1000 repeated bridge cycles
Dart Expando ownership and JS pressure preserve the conditional edge
Dart allocation during a JS job preserves WeakRef kept objects and reentry

limitations: Two runs per variant; practical retention gates are not statistical guarantees.
Display-capped submissions/completions, not maximum throughput or screen presentations.
Completion spans encoding start to a JS notification, not isolated GPU or physical input/display latency.
Private macOS arm64 profile; full CTS, other platforms and full Canvas widget/WPT acceptance not repeated.
